message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side step-line charts compare best-agent scores over 80 iterations on SWE-bench and Polyglot, showing DGM and its ablations against benchmark baselines.","description":"The target is a two-panel chart. Both horizontal axes are labeled “Iterations” and run from 0 to 80 in steps of 10; the vertical axes show “Score of Best Agent.” Lines are dotted step traces with point markers. On the left, the vertical axis is “SWE-bench Score of Best Agent,” with labeled ticks from 0.20 to 0.50 in 0.05 increments. The legend identifies a red dashed “Checked Open-sourced SoTA” horizontal reference at about 0.51, an orange “DGM w/o Open-ended exploration” trace, a green “DGM w/o Self-improve” trace, and a blue “DGM” trace. The orange trace is about 0.20 initially and rises to 0.23 around iteration 37. The green trace starts near 0.20, rises to about 0.28 near iteration 2 and to about 0.39 near iteration 23, then stays level. The blue DGM trace starts near 0.20, rises to 0.25 near iteration 1, 0.41 near 23, 0.43 near 47, and 0.50 near 63, remaining at that level to iteration 80. Thus DGM finishes just below the checked open-source reference and above both ablations. On the right, the vertical axis is “Polyglot Score of Best Agent,” with labeled ticks from 0.15 to 0.35 in 0.05 increments. The purple dashed “Representative Agent Baseline (Aider)” reference is about 0.165. The orange, green, and blue traces correspond to the same DGM variants identified in the left-panel legend. Orange starts near 0.14 and rises to 0.18 around iteration 50. Green starts near 0.14, steps up to about 0.18, 0.24, 0.26, and 0.28, with the last rise near iteration 76. Blue starts near 0.14, then rises to about 0.34 near iteration 14, 0.36 near 34, and 0.375 near 64. All three end above the Aider reference; blue is highest and orange lowest. No arrows, checks, or crosses are shown. Values described and tabulated here are estimated from the plotted lines, not printed point
